title: Fairness and Explainability in Automatic Decision-Making Systems. A challenge for computer science and law
reasoning: The paper features a dedicated section on 'Problematizing the ethical question' and draws extensively from moral philosophy and principles of justice (e.g., utilitarianism, egalitarianism, and Aristotelian principles) to evaluate the concept of fairness in automated systems, making ethics a core component of its analysis.
